notes.title: Endless Dead Development Update
notes.content:
We're busy developing this new VR title, and have several things to share. We've expanded the weapon list in the game to include both realistic and fantasy weapons. The current list now includes, 

M16
Gauss Gun
Standard  Shotgun
Energy Shotgun
Chain Gun
Rocket Launcher
Plasma Gun
Standard Pistol
Energy Pistol
Stun Phaser
Lightning Gun
M1 Garand rifle
Revolver
Kalashnikov AK-107
Flamethrower
G80ROM Grenade Launcher
Renegade Slicer
Bolt Repeater
Thumper Rocket

We've already got the first Boss battle in the game and designed a early sandbox level for testing. We've experimented with several camera angles in VR taking discomfort and visibility into consideration. We've concluded that a near character 3rd person view reduces motion sickness the most, and will most likely ship with that camera angle as the default. 

We should have more info soon, and additional levels and enemies, so stay tuned.
